what_to_detect: A triggered ability with an intervening-if condition on its trigger (CheckSVar$, LifeTotal$, IsPresent$ and the like) whose condition still holds when it resolves, so its effect half acts.
near_miss: An intervening-if triggered ability that fired but whose condition is false when it resolves, so it is removed from the stack and its resolution has no effect events.
record_fields: trigger record fired true, the trigger line's root script carrying an intervening-if parameter
the same ability's resolution record: activation outcome and effect-half events (present or empty)

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect reads a number from an object that left its zone during the same resolution (its last known information).
near_miss: A resolution whose object stayed in place, so current information equals last known information.
record_fields: gen-3 cards.last_known
effect-half events

what_to_detect: A trigger whose condition looks back at the turn's history (CheckSVar$ on a turn count such as attackers declared) fires because the condition held earlier in the turn, even though the creature that met it no longer exists.
near_miss: A trigger of that kind evaluated in a turn where its historical condition is unmet, which does not fire.
record_fields: trigger record fired
trigger line's root CheckSVar$ and the SVar's Count$ definition (sidecar script)
gen-3 player turn_counts

what_to_detect: A resolution whose selector names one colour (all black creatures) affects a multicoloured permanent that has that colour among others.
near_miss: A permanent without that colour, which the resolution leaves unaffected.
record_fields: acting line's ValidCards$ / ValidTgts$ colour test (sidecar script)
snapshot entity colours
effect-half destroyed / zone_change events

what_to_detect: A resolution whose selector excludes one colour (all nonblack creatures) spares a multicoloured permanent that has that colour among others.
near_miss: A permanent without that colour, which the resolution affects.
record_fields: acting line's ValidCards$ colour test (sidecar script)
snapshot entity colours
effect-half destroyed / zone_change events

what_to_detect: A delayed or triggered ability acting on the permanent it remembered after that permanent stopped having the card type it was remembered with, such as returning a former creature.
near_miss: The same kind of ability acting on a remembered permanent that still has that type.
record_fields: gen-3 command.delayed_triggers remembered
snapshot entity types
effect-half zone_change of the remembered entity

what_to_detect: A spell cast with bestow whose target is illegal on resolution does not fizzle but continues resolving as a creature spell (608.3b, 702.103e). Forge stamps that resolution's cost half fizzled and writes no effect half for it, so the record that shows it is a cost half with outcome fizzled acting through the Bestow keyword's line, its permanent on the battlefield, unattached, in the next snapshot.
near_miss: A spell cast with bestow whose target is still legal on resolution: outcome resolved, and its effect half holds the zone change to the battlefield and an attached event.
record_fields: cost-half payload.outcome (fizzled, from GameEventSpellResolved.hasFizzled)
acting line: the Bestow keyword line (sidecar)
the next record's snapshot: the permanent on the battlefield with no attached_to
effect half (absent on the fires side; zone_change and attached on the near miss)

what_to_detect: A mutating creature spell's resolution after which the target's card lists mutate components: it merged.
near_miss: A mutating spell that entered alone because its target was illegal.
record_fields: gen-3 cards.mutate_components

what_to_detect: A copy of a permanent spell resolves and becomes a token permanent: the effect half holds a zone_change from the stack to the battlefield whose subject is a spell copy, and the permanent it became is a token afterwards.
near_miss: A permanent spell that is a card resolves: its zone_change from the stack to the battlefield has a card for subject, which stays a card on the battlefield.
record_fields: effect-half zone_change from Stack to Battlefield

the entering entity's token_script_id in the next record's snapshot (in the effect half's own snapshot, taken before the resolution, the copy is a Forge COPIED_SPELL, not a token, so its token_script_id is null and subject_is_token reads it as a card)
the stack entity's copy_source

what_to_detect: A delayed triggered ability created, as a permanent enters, by a static ability that functions on the stack (dash, blitz, warp): the trigger record of that delayed trigger fires at its stated time. Its creation shows as a delayed_trigger_created event in the effect half of the permanent spell's resolution.
near_miss: The same kind of permanent spell cast without that cost: no delayed trigger is created, so no such trigger record is written and its resolution holds no delayed_trigger_created event.
record_fields: trigger payload.fired of the delayed trigger
the delayed trigger's acting line (the keyword line that spawned it, via the sidecar)
effect-half delayed_trigger_created of the permanent spell's resolution
